item.title: Additional Pittsburgh police officers placed on leave as investigation into bar fight continues
item.description: Three more Pittsburgh police officers have been placed on paid administrative leave after a reported area bar fight, according to police spokeswoman Cara Cruz.

item.title: McDonald’s says focus on value is bringing back customers
item.description: McDonald’s focus on value is paying off.

item.title: Speaker Mike Johnson says he disapproves of Justice Department logging lawmaker searches of Epstein files
item.description: WASHINGTON — Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson said Thursday that he did not think it was appropriate for the Justice Department to be tracking the search histories of lawmakers who are reviewing files from the Jeffrey Epstein investigation.

item.title: Greensburg Central Catholic boys rally in last minute to beat Union in 2A play-in
item.description: Greensburg Central Catholic had not led for the first 31 minutes of their WPIAL Class 2A boys basketball preliminary-round game Thursday. JT Stawovy had not scored in the game for the Centurions.

item.title: Home crowd helps carry Latrobe boys past Mars in basketball playoff opener
item.description: With its 14-point lead shaved to five with just more than a minute to play, Latrobe had to buckle up and hold on down the stretch to win its playoff opener Thursday night.

item.title: Robert Morris men surge past Cleveland State for 3rd straight win, 6th in past 8 games
item.description: The defending champs suddenly are rolling. Surging Robert Morris has come to life in time for the stretch run of the college basketball season with March Madness just around the corner.

item.title: High school roundup for Feb. 12, 2026: Montour gets past McKeesport in Class 5A prelims
item.description: Brandon Bennett scored 19 points, including the go-ahead layup with less than a minute to play, to lead No. 17 Montour to a 53-52 victory over McKeesport in a WPIAL Class 5A boys basketball preliminary round game Thursday night.

item.title: Phillies release Nick Castellanos, who admits to bringing beer into dugout
item.description: CLEARWATER, Fla. — The Philadelphia Phillies released outfielder Nick Castellanos on Thursday after the team was unable to make a deal to trade him. Castellanos then revealed he was benched last season after bringing beer into the dugout during a game.

item.title: Judge grants Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss extra eligibility
item.description: PITTSBORO, Miss. — In saying “the NCAA ignored its own rules,” a Mississippi judge granted Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss a preliminary injunction Thursday against college athletics’ governing body, allowing him to receive an extra year of eligibility so he can play next season.
